description: This file contains the implementation of the Smarty_Internal_Resource_String class, which is an internal plugin resource class for the Smarty template engine. It handles string-based template resources, including decoding, loading, and managing template source data.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Resource_String
classes.description: A plugin resource class for Smarty that manages string-based templates, providing functionality to populate metadata, decode resources, load content, and determine resource names and timestamps.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the source object with metadata based on the resource.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Loads the template source content from the resource.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes the resource string if it is base64 or URL encoded.

methods.name: buildUniqueResourceName
methods.description: Builds a unique resource name based on the class and decoded resource name.

methods.name: getBasename
methods.description: Returns an empty string as the resource's basename.

methods.name: checkTimestamps
methods.description: Indicates whether to check timestamps; always returns false for string resources.
